title: When the Rivergate Wakes
author: Marguerite Zhou
blurb: Lior Montrose, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
